title: If a CPU cycle took one second

captions.text: Your CPU spends most of its life !waiting.!
captions.say: Your C P U spends most of its life waiting.

captions.text: Slow it down so a single clock tick takes *one second.*
Grabbing data from its closest cache: about *three seconds.*

captions.say: Reading from an S S D: days.

captions.text: That's why chips are covered in *caches,*
and why fast code is mostly about keeping data *close.*
Follow: tomorrow, why loading bars lie.
captions.say: Follow. Tomorrow: why loading bars lie.
